jobs.want: Generate concept art from a prompt
jobs.detail: `2d/workflows/z-image-turbo.json` (modern, Apache-2.0) or `2d/workflows/sdxl-base-art.json` (SDXL, painted look)

jobs.want: Control composition from an existing image
jobs.detail: `2d/workflows/controlnet-union.json` (one model, many modes) · `2d/workflows/sdxl-controlnet-canny.json` (canny only)

jobs.want: Cut an object out (transparent PNG)
jobs.detail: `2d/workflows/remove-bg.json` (BiRefNet)

jobs.want: Mask by description ("the knight", "the roof")
jobs.detail: `2d/workflows/sam3-segment.json` (SAM 3, text-prompted)

jobs.want: Get a depth map
jobs.detail: `2d/workflows/depth-normal.json` (DepthAnythingV2)

jobs.want: Inpaint / remove / add an object
jobs.detail: `2d/workflows/inpaint.json`

jobs.want: Make the picture bigger (outpaint)
jobs.detail: `2d/workflows/outpaint.json` (invents the new area; the original stays pixel-exact)

jobs.want: Extend a frame with its own content (not invented)
jobs.detail: `scripts/pad_image.py` (mirror band + mask) → `2d/workflows/inpaint.json`

jobs.want: Fix a colour or tone cast across a result
jobs.detail: `scripts/color_match.py` (palette match; global cast only - see E20)

jobs.want: Relight / change the lighting
jobs.detail: `2d/workflows/qwen-edit-gguf.json` (faithful)

jobs.want: Compose a scene from parts (bg + character + prop)
jobs.detail: `scripts/compose_scene.py` → `2d/workflows/compose-harmonize.json`

jobs.want: Keep two subjects from merging
jobs.detail: `2d/workflows/regional-prompting.json` (a single prompt *drops* one)

jobs.want: Keep a character consistent across images
jobs.detail: `2d/workflows/qwen-edit-gguf.json` (design) · `2d/workflows/instantid-character.json` (tight face) · `2d/workflows/pulid-identity.json` (face + free composition)

jobs.want: Get a pose from a photo
jobs.detail: `2d/workflows/pose-extract.json` (a photo of a person -> the skeleton image a ControlNet reads, plus the keypoints JSON)

jobs.want: Put a character in a specific pose
jobs.detail: `2d/workflows/pose-extract.json` (get the pose from a photo) · `2d/workflows/qwen-edit-gguf.json` (instruction - best for a specific pose) · `2d/workflows/pose-skeleton.json` (skeleton cue - holds a **coarse stance** at `strength 1.5` + `end_percent 0.5`, but not limb angles)

jobs.want: Transfer a style or reference look
jobs.detail: `2d/workflows/qwen-edit-gguf.json` (multi-image reference) · `2d/workflows/ipadapter-style.json` (superseded)

jobs.want: Turn one image into a multi-view turnaround
jobs.detail: `2d/workflows/sv3d-turnaround.json` (SV3D_p; a 21-frame 360° orbit, no mesh needed — take frames 0/5/10/15 for 0/90/180/270)

jobs.want: Pixel art
jobs.detail: `2d/workflows/pixel-art.json` (from a prompt) · `pixel-art-convert.json` (existing image, faithful) · `pixel-art-restyle.json` (existing image, redrawn) · `scripts/atlas.py` (pack a sheet / slice one - local)

jobs.want: Build a sprite sheet / atlas
jobs.detail: `scripts/atlas.py` (pack images into a sheet / slice one back - local, `--verify` checks the round-trip)

jobs.want: Upscale / restore (incl. faces)
jobs.detail: `2d/workflows/upscale-seedvr2.json` (Apache-2.0; `resolution` = image size for *restore*)

jobs.want: Upscale faithfully (GAN, invents nothing)
jobs.detail: `2d/workflows/upscale.json` — non-commercial `4x-UltraSharp`; prefer SeedVR2 above

jobs.want: Make a texture tile seamlessly
jobs.detail: `2d/workflows/seamless-texture.json` (`method="offset"`)

jobs.want: Turn a texture into PBR maps
jobs.detail: `2d/workflows/pbr-material.json` (maps) -> `scripts/pack_pbr_material.py` (the packed map Unity needs) or `scripts/make_gltf_material.py` (glTF packing, optional GLB)

jobs.want: Push a 2D material into 3D
jobs.detail: `scripts/make_gltf_material.py` (glTF-valid material + optional GLB)

jobs.want: Make a 3D model from an image/description
jobs.detail: `3d/workflows/hy3d-full-workflow.json` · multi-view: `3d/workflows/hy3d-multiview-workflow.json`

jobs.want: Rig a character
jobs.detail: `3d/workflows/unirig-humanoid-workflow.json` (bpy via pixi — Linux only)

jobs.want: Animate a sprite across poses (make sprite sheets)
jobs.detail: `2d/workflows/pose-extract.json` (one pose per photo) -> `2d/workflows/pose-skeleton.json` (render each; keep the contrasts ~40 deg apart) -> `scripts/atlas.py` (pack the frames)

jobs.want: Sweep parameters into a labelled grid
jobs.detail: scripts/sweep_workflow.py (any shipped flow, any widget, 1-2 axes - image-conditioned flows included) · scripts/sweep.py (plain text-to-image, sampler axes) · scripts/sweep_outpaint.py (the outpaint seam specifically, with a boundary-step metric)

jobs.want: Move files to and from the box
jobs.detail: `scripts/comfy_io.py` (HTTP-based)

jobs.want: Animate a character from a driving video
jobs.detail: `video/workflows/wan-animate-motion.json` (a still character + a driving video you supply; the motion is transferred directly) · use `scripts/wan_segment.py` to process longer clips in segments

jobs.want: Recover a 3D motion clip from a video
jobs.detail: `animation/workflows/sam3d-motion.json` (footage -> an animated skeletal GLB, for the engine to retarget)

jobs.want: Change a clip's frame rate
jobs.detail: `video/workflows/frame-interpolate.json` (in-between frames are synthesised, so a clip smoothly gains frames instead of being re-tagged - one factor knob)

jobs.want: Generate music or a song from a text prompt
jobs.detail: `audio/workflows/ace-step.json` (tags + optional lyrics; ACE-Step 1.5, MIT, 9.3 GB all-in-one)

jobs.want: Keep a soundtrack in the same style as a reference
jobs.detail: `audio/workflows/ace-step-style.json` (a reference track is encoded and re-sampled at a chosen `denoise` - it retains the reference strongly rather than restyling it)

jobs.want: Generate a sound effect or an ambience from a text prompt
jobs.detail: `audio/workflows/stable-audio-3-sfx.json` (footsteps, doors, impacts and short ambience - Stable Audio 3)

jobs.want: Restyle a track in a new style (cover)
jobs.detail: `audio/workflows/yue2-cover.json` (YuE 2 melody transplant - the only restyle route; **non-commercial** weights, so research use only; the model picks the length, and new lyrics need a sung source - E22)

jobs.want: Generate a song that actually sings
jobs.detail: `audio/workflows/ace-step-xl-sft.json` (**MIT** - lyric-full on clear-lead styles) or `audio/workflows/ace-step-v1-35b.json` (**MIT** - ~2x faster/lighter and it sings shouty styles); E23 kept both: they split by style, not by rank

jobs.want: Repair a region of a track (re-sing a span, refill a deleted passage)
jobs.detail: `audio/workflows/ace-step-latent-repaint.json` (ACE-Step core + a custom node `SetAudioLatentNoiseMask` which masks a time band of the audio latent and resamples only it)

jobs.want: Generate narration or a voice-over from text
jobs.detail: `audio/workflows/chatterbox-narration.json` (Chatterbox TTS, **MIT**) - a script to speech, with a 5-10 s `audio_prompt` to clone a voice - or `audio/workflows/chatterbox-narration-turbo.json` (**Turbo**, ~1 GB) when you want **paralinguistic tags** like `[laugh]` (E28); 24 kHz mono, so normalise before mixing

jobs.want: Generate a dialogue scene
jobs.detail: `audio/workflows/chatterbox-dialogue.json` (Chatterbox TTS, **MIT** - a `SPEAKER A:`/`SPEAKER B:` script with two **required** 5-10 s voice references, mixed scene **plus per-speaker tracks**; a separated vocal stem works as a reference, E26b)

jobs.want: Make a posed facing set from a rigged model
jobs.detail: `scripts/render_glb_poses.py` (render a rigged GLB's clips as pose x facing PNGs - bpy, one fixed camera, adjustable gear) -> `2d/workflows/pixel-art-convert.json` (faithful pixelation, one shared palette) -> `scripts/restore_alpha.py` (put the render's transparency back) -> `scripts/atlas.py` (pack)

jobs.want: Animate my own character from a prompt
jobs.detail: `video/workflows/wan-vace-reference.json` (VACE **reference-to-video**: your own character image + a text prompt -> a clip that keeps her identity and acts out the prompt, **no driving clip**; `wan2.1_vace_14B_fp8_scaled.safetensors`, 17.6 GB, Apache-2.0; 81 frames at 768² takes **45.5 min** on this box; identity holds, but the last third drifts, E13b). To copy motion from a clip instead, use `wan-animate-motion.json` (S18)

jobs.want: Give a clip a camera you chose
jobs.detail: `video/workflows/wan-camera-control.json` - a still plus a **preset camera trajectory** (Static / Pan / Zoom / orbit) instead of the model inventing its own camera, which drifts; `wan2.1_fun_camera_v1.1_1.3B_bf16` (3.23 GB, Apache-2.0) and **115 s per 81-frame cell** - the cheapest motion route here (E18). Note the canvas knobs live on the `WanCameraEmbedding`, which overrides the target node's own

jobs.want: Pad a portrait image to 16:9 for a landscape video run
jobs.detail: `scripts/letterbox_16x9.py` - one command that pads the image to the target aspect instead of letting the video flow crop it (measured: our `char_heroine.png` loses her head in an 832x480 frame); then set the camera/motion flow's width/height to match. Pairs with S29

jobs.want: Turn a generated clip into a VFX flipbook
jobs.detail: `scripts/flipbook.py` - a clip (webp/gif/webm/mp4) or a frame sequence -> an engine sheet plus a manifest carrying the frame rate, cell size, grid and loop mode. Samples `--frames` frames over a `--window` of the clip, orders them (`--loop pingpong` is the only seamless one for any source), keys the backdrop to alpha (`--key luma` / `chroma`) or leaves it additive, and packs the cells. Measured: a 33-frame flame clip at 8 source frames reads as one coherent effect, the ping-pong seam is 0.3 px, and a chroma-green source fails at the image stage (E21)

jobs.want: Put our character into footage
jobs.detail: `video/workflows/wan-animate-mix.json` - WanAnimateToVideo **Mix mode** (character replacement): a driving clip of a person in a scene + a **portrait** reference -> our character plays their part, background and lighting kept. The 14B host is *cheap* here: lightx2v recipe runs 77 frames at 640x640 in 375 s. The mask is generated in-graph  and `background_video` is the video with the character painted black. A full-body reference loses the face on close-up-driven footage, a portrait holds it

jobs.want: Make our character speak an audio file
jobs.detail: `video/workflows/wan-infinitetalk.json` - InfiniteTalk single-speaker: a **still portrait** + an audio file -> a clip of the character speaking it, **with the audio embedded** in the output. A `seconds` knob sizes the clip (`length` is derived 4n+1 in-graph, fps pinned at 25 - the audio conditioning is sampled for 25 fps, so fps is deliberately not a knob); trim the audio to match, since only the first `length` frames' worth of audio is spoken. Longer audio chains segments through `previous_frames` (first 3.24 s at defaults; continuations advance 2.88 s); longer audio via scripts/talk_chain.py (E21: 8.8 s -> 221 frames exact)

jobs.want: Make our character perform an audio file
jobs.detail: `video/workflows/wan-s2v.json` - Wan2.2-S2V (audio-driven performance): a **still portrait** + an audio file -> the character *performs* it (head movement, expression, articulation - broader than S32's lip-sync), with the audio embedded. A `seconds` knob sizes the chunk (`length` derived 4n+1, fps pinned at 16, shortest clip 4.75 s); trim the audio to match. Note the per-route audio encoder: this flow uses `wav2vec2_large_english`, S32 uses chinese-base. `LatentCut`/`LatentConcat` is the first-frame hack, not chaining - longer audio needs `WanSoundImageToVideoExtend` (not wired here yet)

jobs.want: Upscale a video while keeping its timebase and audio
jobs.detail: `video/workflows/video-upscale-seedvr2.json` - SeedVR2 processes temporal IMAGE batches, then `CreateVideo` reattaches source FPS + audio. Measured on two clips: an 80-frame 640x640 talking head -> 960x960 in **150 s**, and a 121-frame 720x1280 dance -> 960x1706 in **375 s**; frame count/FPS held, with no extra temporal seam flicker measured on the talking-head sample (E20). Uses SeedVR2 3B fp16, batch 5, overlap 2, CPU offload. SeedVR2 reconstructs detail rather than pixel-exactly enlarging, so inspect drift.
